The session status shows it's 2026.5.6. Let me figure out what day of the week that is.

2026-05-06. Let me calculate:

A known reference: 2026-01-01 is a Thursday.

Let me count the days from Jan 1 to May 6.

January: 31 days, so Feb 1 = day 32
February: 28 days (2026 is not a leap year - 2026/4 = 506.5, not divisible by 4), so Mar 1 = day 32 + 28 = 60
March: 31 days, so Apr 1 = day 60 + 31 = 91
April: 30 days, so May 1 = day 91 + 30 = 121
May 6 = day 121 + 5 = 126

So May 6 is the 126th day of the year.

From Jan 1 (Thursday) to May 6: 126 - 1 = 125 days difference.
125 mod 7 = 6 (since 7*17 = 119, 125-119 = 6)

Thursday + 6 days = Wednesday? Let me recount.

Jan 1 = Thursday (day 0)
Jan 2 = Friday (day 1)
...
Adding 125 days to Thursday.

125 / 7 = 17 remainder 6.

Thursday + 6 = Wednesday

So 2026-05-06 is a Wednesday.

Let me double check another way. Jan 1, 2026 is a Thursday.

Jan has 31 days, so Feb 1 is a Sunday (31 mod 7 = 3, Thursday + 3 = Sunday).
Feb has 28 days, so Mar 1 is a Sunday (28 mod 7 = 0, Sunday + 0 = Sunday).
Mar has 31 days, so Apr 1 is a Wednesday (31 mod 7 = 3, Sunday + 3 = Wednesday).
Apr has 30 days, so May 1 is a Friday (30 mod 7 = 2, Wednesday + 2 = Friday).
May 6 is Friday + 5 = Wednesday.

Yep, May 6, 2026 is a Wednesday.
